t: You're looking at an extra tall red telephone box in Maida Vale, a version of the K6 kiosk designed by Philippe Starck. Starck is a French designer, born in 1949, known for interiors, architecture, furniture, boats and everyday household objects. He is regarded as a pioneer of democratic design, which aims to give people the best possible service from the minimum of materials. His most popular pieces came in the 1980s and 1990s, and this unusual kiosk is a small London example of his work.
